generation_receipt_policy: Charge every current receipt, including rejected or discarded work, plus the unique ancestor closure of reused data. Receipts are immutable task-runner records; candidate declarations are not authoritative.
candidate_time_formula: actual_current_work_elapsed_seconds + sum(exclusive_generation_seconds for unique inherited receipts from earlier candidates)
trajectory_time_formula: actual trajectory wall-clock elapsed time; never add inherited time again
receipt_batch_policy: Reusing any output of a generation batch inherits the full batch receipt and its ancestors, including rejected attempts. A receipt is charged once per candidate. Receipt times exclude time already attributed to a parent or another receipt.
enforcement_status: CPU arithmetic is implemented; trusted runtime collection, lineage validation and online stopping remain Harbor runner integration.
